inventory.name: APAD / IGP asset-data-igp: Bangladesh brick kilns (Brick_kilns_BAN_coal.csv)
inventory.coverage: The inventory lists kilns only west of about 90.9° E, in 6 of Bangladesh's 8 divisions (Barisal, Dhaka, Khulna, Mymensingh, Rajshahi, Rangpur). Chattogram and Sylhet divisions and the east of Dhaka division have no kilns in it: not covered, not free of kilns.
inventory.caveat: An asset list with modelled attributes and positions, not field-verified. It shows where kilns stand, not whether one is firing today.

cross_check.reference: Bangladesh brick kilns from space (Sentinel-2 detector trained on SentinelKilnDB), dry season 2024-25
cross_check.note: Most APAD positions sit on a kiln seen from space, but some do not, and APAD lists about half of the kilns in the Sentinel-2 map: a count from it is a floor, not the full number.

cropland.source: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, class 40 (Cropland), read at the ~74 m overview (CC BY 4.0)
cropland.method: share of cropland pixels in a 1 km disc around each kiln

boundary.source: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries v5.1.2 (public domain)

emissions.source: APAD modelled estimates per kiln: capacity times an emission factor for the kiln type (fixed-chimney or zigzag); not measured at the kiln
